schemeContent.briefDescription: The ‘Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme’ is a comprehensive Group Personal Accident Insurance Scheme, implemented by Coconut Development Board in association with Public Insurance companies for Coconut Tree Climbers/Neera Technicians/Coconut Harvesters.

children.text: The "Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme," under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare and implemented by the Coconut Development Board, provides coverage for Coconut Tree Climbers (CTC), Neera Technicians, and Coconut Harvesters in all coconut-growing states. The scheme offers a sum assured of ₹7.00 lakhs for 24-hour accident-related risks, including death. The annual premium is ₹956, with ₹717 covered by the Board and ₹239 paid by the beneficiary via DD or online mode.
Objective:
The aim is to attract unemployed youth to show more interest in the agriculture sector.
To overcome the shortage of coconut tree climbers, the Board launched a skill development program called 'Friends of Coconut Tree (FoCT).

Interested youths were imparted training on coconut tree climbing with a machine specially developed for the purpose as well as on scientific management of the palm, plant protection techniques, and other related activities.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md:

The scheme offers a sum assured of ₹7.00 lakhs for 24-hour accident-related risks, including death. The annual premium is ₹956, with ₹717 covered by the Board and ₹239 paid by the beneficiary via DD or online mode.

en.documentsRequired_md:
> **Documents required to apply under the scheme;**


1. Aadhaar card
1. Proof of age
1. Caste certificate, if applicable
1. Declaration for Assignment
1. Declaration Form
1. Certificate issued by competent authority stating that the applicant is currently engaged in skilled labour as a Coconut Tree Climber/Neera Technician/Harvester
1. Payment details
1. Any other document, as required

> **In case of Accident:**


1. Original Discharge summary/ OP Ticket
1. Original Medical Bills ( duly certified by a doctor)
1. Original Lab reports(if any)
1. Immobilizations Certificate (Minimum 5 days continuous disablement is required)
1. Fitness Certificate
1. Disability Certificate (In case of disablement due to accident)
1. FIR/GD Entry/CSR/Police Report (In case of road accident)
1. NEFT details (Bank name, Branch, Account Number and IFSC)
1. Duly signed claim voucher 

> **In case of Death:**


1. Original Medical Reports
1. Original Death Certificate
1. Legal Heirship certificate
1. Post Mortem Report
1. FIR
1. Newspaper cutting
1. Viscera Report (if any)
1. Inquest Report
1. NEFT details (Bank name, Branch, Account Number and IFSC)
1. Duly signed claim voucher
